No finite check is substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two lowest natural weight coefficients and all their label geometries are determined for an infinite canonical graph family, not just a restatement of a known minimum. They expose a sharp stability law: all optimum deployments synchronize the missing-matching pairs, while every next-weight deployment breaks precisely one pair. The exact parity-dependent difference between weak Italian and strong Roman optimizer families makes the distinction between two established protection invariants concrete; it is not implied by knowing their scalar minima. Reproducible exhaustive checks provide benchmarks. No assertion of application performance or general graph classification is made.
